source.title: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Virtual (ASAv) Data Sheet

fw_throughput_mbps.label: Stateful inspection throughput (maximum)
notes: Throughput measured with 1500B User Datagram Protocol (UDP) traffic measured under ideal test conditions.
- Measured on instances with Accelerated Networking (AN) enable

fw_throughput_multiprotocol_mbps.label: Stateful inspection throughput (multiprotocol)
notes: “Multiprotocol” refers to a traffic profile consisting primarily of TCP-based protocols or applications like HTTP, SMTP, FTP, IMAPv4, BitTorrent, and DNS.
- Measured on instances with Accelerated Networking (AN) enable

ipsec_throughput_mbps.label: IPsec VPN throughput (AES 450B UDP test)
notes: The VPN throughput and the number of sessions depend on the ASA device configuration and VPN traffic patterns. These elements should be taken into consideration as part of your capacity planning.
- Measured on instances with Accelerated Networking (AN) enable

new_sessions_per_sec.label: Connections per second
notes: - Measured on instances with Accelerated Networking (AN) enable

concurrent_sessions.label: Concurrent sessions
notes: - Measured on instances with Accelerated Networking (AN) enable

vpn_peers_max.label: IPsec VPN peers
notes: - Measured on instances with Accelerated Networking (AN) enable

ravpn_sessions_max.label: Cisco AnyConnect or clientless VPN user sessions
notes: - Measured on instances with Accelerated Networking (AN) enable
